description: Climate Forced Hydropower Simulations Using NASA NEX-GDDP is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ana Lucia Caceres, Paulina Jaramillo (Carnegie Mellon University). This dataset includes the results of simulations of future hydropower availability for power plants in Brazil, Colombia, and Peru. These simulations have been forced using NASA's Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections (NEX-GDDP) dataset, which includes maximum temperature, minimum temperature, and precipitation simulations from 21 Global Climate Models (GCM) and three scenarios. Coverage: several countries (BR, CO, PE); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
